lines.en: Leo, did you see the moving truck in front of the building? If Mrs Park had not moved, we would still be neighbours.
lines.pt: Leo, você viu o caminhão de mudança na frente do prédio? Se a Sra. Park não tivesse se mudado, ainda seríamos vizinhos.

lines.en: Which Park? The woman from the top floor? If she had told us sooner, we would have organised a party.
lines.pt: Qual Park? A mulher do último andar? Se ela tivesse nos avisado antes, teríamos organizado uma festa.

lines.en: Exactly. She was offered a better job in Portland, so she decided quickly. If she had stayed, she would not be so happy now.
lines.pt: Exato. Ofereceram a ela um emprego melhor em Portland, então decidiu rápido. Se tivesse ficado, não estaria tão feliz agora.

lines.en: That is true. I moved here five years ago, and if I had not met you, I would probably feel lonely in this hall.
lines.pt: É verdade. Mudei para cá há cinco anos e, se não tivesse conhecido você, provavelmente me sentiria sozinho neste corredor.

lines.en: Same here. If the landlord had not raised the rent last spring, half of our neighbours would still live on this floor.
lines.pt: Comigo também. Se o proprietário não tivesse aumentado o aluguel na primavera, metade dos nossos vizinhos ainda moraria neste andar.

lines.en: I am thinking about leaving too. If the rent were lower, I would not be looking at other apartments every evening.
lines.pt: Também penso em sair. Se o aluguel fosse menor, eu não estaria olhando outros apartamentos toda noite.

lines.en: Do not rush. If I had moved last year, I would be paying even more now, because the whole city has become expensive.
lines.pt: Não se apresse. Se eu tivesse me mudado no ano passado, estaria pagando ainda mais agora, porque a cidade inteira ficou cara.

lines.en: Good point. I will have to take care of her plants. She asked whether I could water them until Sunday.
lines.pt: Boa observação. Vou ter que cuidar das plantas dela. Ela perguntou se eu podia regá-las até domingo.

lines.en: If she had given the keys to me, I would be watering them already, and you would be free.
lines.pt: Se ela tivesse dado as chaves a mim, eu já estaria regando, e você estaria livre.

lines.en: It is a pleasure. And if the new tenants are friendly, maybe the building will feel like a community again.
lines.pt: É um prazer. E se os novos inquilinos forem simpáticos, talvez o prédio volte a parecer uma comunidade.

lines.en: I hope so. Let us leave a note on every door and invite them for coffee in the hall on Saturday.
lines.pt: Espero que sim. Vamos deixar um bilhete em cada porta e convidá-los para um café no corredor no sábado.

facts.label: Mudanças e consequências
facts.sub: If + had not + particípio, would still + infinitivo.

facts.label: If + had + particípio, would + infinitivo
facts.sub: Use para ligar uma mudança passada à situação de hoje: If she had not moved, we would still be neighbours. O if olha para trás e o resultado olha para agora.

facts.label: would still + verbo
facts.sub: Would still mostra que a situação continuaria até hoje: We would still live here. Em português, “ainda moraríamos aqui”. A palavra still vem depois de would.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: If she had not moved, we would still be neighbours is a mixed conditional.
We say “we would still have been neighbours” for a present result.
items.why: For the present, use would still be.

items.s: The if-clause uses the past perfect.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: If she had not moved, we would still be neighbours is a mixed conditi… → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “we would still have been neighbours” for a present result. → Falso (For the present, use would still be.)
The if-clause uses the past perfect. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: If she had not moved · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy evening in Seattle. Gabe walks down the hall. A truck waits outside. Boxes stand by a door. Leo comes out to look. The neighbours stop and talk.

“Leo, did you see the moving truck in front of the building? If Mrs Park had not moved, we would still be neighbours.” says Gabe. “Which Park? The woman from the top floor? If she had told us sooner, we would have organised a party.” says Leo. “Exactly. She was offered a better job in Portland, so she decided quickly. If she had stayed, she would not be so happy now.” says Gabe.
